**NG Setup without a Supported TA List is refused**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NGAP / Handling of Unknown, Unforeseen and Erroneous Protocol Data / Missing IE or IE group |
| Tags | negative |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 15s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | no procedure first |

## Clauses

- TS 38.413 9.2.6.1 Supported TA List (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: criticality column reads "GLOBAL reject" in V15.0.0, "YES reject" by V15.13.0; Rel-19: semantics add that the IE is ignored for an A-IoT-only node; still mandatory, criticality reject)
- TS 38.413 10.3.5 Reject IE bullet 1 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-NGSETUP-MISSING-TALIST.md).
